snippet.title: Keeping The Home Fire Burning | Beaconfall (Settlement Builder Tower Defence)
snippet.description:
Beaconfall is a part settlement builder part tower defender game, where we need to defend our lighthouse against waves of enemies who want to knock it down and extinguish it's light!

To help us in the fight against the undead hordes we need to build up our little settlement. We can build economy buildings, to provide food, wood, stone, that kind of thing, and this is important because it helps us increase the amount of villagers we have.

The villagers can then dash around and do various jobs, such as woodcutting or mining, but also they can be stationed in our defensive buildings, such as towers!

Also to help us defend we've got spiky wooden walls, mines, archers, that sort of thing, plus if we upgrade the lighthouse it can have special powers which can zap the bad guys with lightning or chuck meteors at them!

However as time ticks by the waves of enemies get tougher and tougher, and our final battle isn't helped by the game going a bit wibbly...


Beaconfall can be found here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4481530/BEACONFALL/

Beaconfall - is a dynamic strategy game about defending a settlement on an island surrounded by darkness.

Build structures, gather resources, and assign villagers between work and defense. Every building either boosts your economy or strengthens your fortifications - but you’ll never have enough hands.

When a wave begins, enemies emerge from the gloom and attack from multiple directions. Staff your towers, place traps, and make decisions under pressure.

The lighthouse is the heart of your settlement. It holds back the darkness - and it can become a powerful weapon if you choose to invest in its upgrades.

Each run lasts around 20–30 minutes and takes place on a procedurally generated island. Different scenarios, unique island layouts, and bosses demand new strategies and builds.

Survive the final assault and prove your light is stronger than the dark.

FEATURES
Build and grow your settlement in real time
Defend against enemy waves in a tower defense format
Upgrade buildings and unlock new specializations
Use a tactical pause to make smart decisions
Procedurally generated islands
Multiple scenarios with unique bosses

----------------------------
